source_text: Περὶ τοῦ τοὺς ἐκ τῶν αἱρέσεων, τοὐτέστι Ναυατιανῶν, ἤτοι Φωτεινιανῶν, ἢ Τεσσαρεσκαιδεκατιτῶν, ἐπιστρεφόμενους, εἴτε κατηχουμένους, εἴτε πιστοὺς τοὺς παρ᾽ ἐκείνοις, μὴ προσδέχεσθαι, πρὶν ἀναθεματίσωσι πᾶσαν αἵρεσιν, ἐξαιρέτως δὲ ἐν ᾗ κατείχοντο· καὶ τότε λοιπὸν τοὺς λεγομένους παρ᾽ αὐτοῖς πιστούς, ἐκμαθάνοντας τὰ τῆς πίστεως σύμβολα, χρισθέντας τε τῷ ἁγίῳ χρίσματι, οὕτω κοινωνεῖν τῶν μυστηρίων τῶν ἁγίων. Ἐ ρ μ η ν ε ί α. Ἀκολούθως μὲ τὸν ζ΄. τῆς β΄. λέγει καὶ ὁ παρών Κανών, διορίζων, ὅτι οἱ Ναυτινιανοὶ (περὶ ὢν ὅρᾳ τὸν η΄. τῆς α΄.) καὶ οἱ Φωτινιανοὶ(1) (περὶ ὢν ὅρᾳ τὸν α΄. τῆς β΄.) καὶ οἱ Τεσσαρεσκαιδεκατίται(περὶ ὢν ὅρᾳ τὸν ζ΄. τῆς β΄.) ἐπιστρέφοντες εἰς τὴν ὀρθοδοξίαν, νά μὴ δέχωνται εἰς τὴν κοινωνίαν τῶν Μυστηρίων πρὸ τοῦ νά ἀναθεματίσουν κάθε ἄλλην αἵρεσιν, μάλιστα δὲ τὴν ἐδικὴν των, εἴτε κατηχούμενοι εἶναι, εἴτε οἱ παρ’ αὐτοῖς ὀνομαζόμενοι πιστοί. Καὶ ἀφ’ οὐ τοῦτο ποιήσουν καὶ μάθουν τὰ τῆς ὀρθοδόξου πίστεως δόγματα, τότε νά χρίωνται μὲ τὸ ἅγιον Μύρον, καὶ οὕτω νά μεταλαμβάνωσι τὰ θεία Μυστήρια, ἐπειδὴ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἀπαραλλάκτως, ὡς καὶ οἱ ὀρθόδοξοι, καὶ διὰ τοῦτο δέν ἐχρειάζοντο νά βαπτισθοῦν δεύτερον. Ὅρᾳ καὶ τὸν μς΄. καὶ μζ΄. Ἀποστολικόν, καὶ μάλιστα τὸν ζ΄. τῆς β΄.
thought_title: Reception of returning Novatians, Photinians, and Quartodecimans
orientation: The Council of Laodicea decrees how heretics from three named sects are to be received back into the church.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning the [matter] of the [ones] from the heresies, that is of [the] Novatians, or of [the] Photinians, or of [the] Fourteenthers, turning [back], whether catechumens, whether faithful [ones] the [ones] among those, not to receive [them], before they anathematize every heresy, but especially [the one] in which they were held; and then henceforth the [ones] called among them faithful [ones], learning the symbols of the faith, and anointed with the holy chrism, thus to partake of the mysteries of the holy [ones]. Interpretation. Following with the 7th of the 2nd says also the present Canon, decreeing, that the Novatians (concerning whom see the 8th of the 1st) and the Photinians (concerning whom see the 1st of the 2nd) and the Fourteenthers (concerning whom see the 7th of the 2nd) turning to the orthodoxy, that they should not be received into the communion of the Mysteries before the [time] to anathematize every other heresy, but especially their own, whether catechumens they are, whether the [ones] among them named faithful [ones]. And after this they do and learn the dogmas of the orthodox faith, then they should be anointed with the holy Myron, and thus they should partake of the divine Mysteries, since they were baptized without difference, as also the orthodox [ones], and through this they did not need to be baptized a second [time]. See also the 46th and 47th Apostolic, and especially the 7th of the 2nd.

choices.why: The participle denotes those turning back to the church; 'returning' keeps the motion and the present force.
The phrase distinguishes the heretics' own 'faithful' from orthodox faithful; 'among those people' preserves the prepositional force.
The glossary bans 'anathema' as a noun but the verb 'anathematize' is the natural English form and preserves the technical force.
Literal rendering of σύμβολα; the creedal sense is clear from context without importing 'creed'.

choices.english: to share in the holy mysteries
choices.why: The glossary requires 'communion' for κοινωνία, but here the verb κοινωνεῖν with genitive is rendered 'share in' to keep the verbal force and avoid a noun.
rejected: to have communion of the holy mysteries
to commune of the holy mysteries

choices.why: The passive of κατέχω suggests being held fast by the heresy; 'were held' keeps the passive and the constraint.

pass_b_english: Concerning those from the heresies—that is, Novatians, Photinians, or Quartodecimans—who are returning, whether catechumens or faithful among those people: they are not to be received until they anathematize every heresy, and especially the one in which they were held. Then, after that, those called faithful among them, once they have learned thoroughly the symbols of the faith and have been anointed with the holy chrism, may share in the holy mysteries.

Interpretation. Following canon 7 of the Second Council, the present canon also decrees that Novatians (concerning whom see canon 8 of the First Council), Photinians (concerning whom see canon 1 of the Second Council), and Quartodecimans (concerning whom see canon 7 of the Second Council) who are returning to orthodoxy are not to be received into the communion of the mysteries before they anathematize every other heresy, and especially their own, whether they are catechumens or those called faithful among them. And after they do this and learn the doctrines of the orthodox faith, then they are to be anointed with the holy chrism, and in this way they are to partake of the divine mysteries, since they were baptized in exactly the same manner as the orthodox, and for this reason they did not need to be baptized a second time. See also Apostolic Canons 46 and 47, and especially canon 7 of the Second Council.
